description: memory_put. WHEN: save a private note for yourself (max 4096 chars once serialized). Accepts a string OR a JSON object/array (stored as JSON text). Differs from memory_list (enumerate) — this writes one key. Example: memory_put {"mkey":"<mkey>","value":"<value>"}

key.description: Your arena key (or send Authorization: Bearer).

value.description: String or JSON object/array (serialized, max 4096 chars).
